audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 read Jax while whys[2] says the slow 'evens the trade', level 6 read Jax while whys[4] says there is no clear edge, and first item read Skill while whys[5] hands it to his item spike.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row, and the packet chart agrees with all seven whys[] lines already on the page.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 and 4 to Skill at 5/10, row 5 to Jax at 3/10, as matched full/content pairs. diffRating 8.5/10 to 7/10 so the number stops contradicting the EVEN label and the 49.52% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: His ultimate is called 'Grandmaster's Might' in four places and credited with a third-hit stun.
audit.why: Riot's data names it Grandmaster-at-Arms, and its third-attack bonus is magic damage — the active adds armour and magic resist. The only stun in his kit is Counter Strike.
audit.corrected: Real name used, the third-hit effect stated as magic damage, and the stun moved back to Counter Strike where it belongs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. The page never says Dark Procession blocks Leap Strike, and never says what Counter Strike actually dodges.
audit.why: Dark Procession creates terrain and Leap Strike is a dash, so the wall denies his engage rather than merely cutting his retreat. Counter Strike dodges all incoming basic attacks for its duration — which means every Mist Walker attack and every Maiden attack whiffs too, not just yours. That is why swarming into an active E is the losing line.
audit.corrected: Both written in: the terrain block into spikes[0] and wants.you[0], the swarm-wide dodge into dosFull[0].d and mid, with Counter Strike's 17s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: No trade tell was given for his opener.
audit.why: Empower is an auto-attack reset on 7s at rank 1, so the wind-up precedes the damage.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Counter Strike and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Counter Strike and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Jax carry threat 10/10.
edits.after: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7/10, Jax carry threat 10/10.

edits.before: Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges every basic attack, ghouls included. 17s at rank 1.

edits.before: Jax's first item (BorK/Triforce) plus Grandmaster's Might outscales your single-item duel damage.
edits.after: Jax's first item (BorK or Triforce) plus Grandmaster-at-Arms outscales your one-item damage.

edits.before: Jax owns levels 1-2: his Leap Strike + Empower combo out-trades your clunky melee autos before you have ghouls or Maiden, so last-hit safely and don't walk into Q range at low HP.
edits.after: Jax owns levels 1-2: Leap Strike plus Empower out-trades your clunky autos before ghouls exist. Empower is an auto reset on 7s, so the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: Around 3-6 it evens out — your Mourning Mist (E) slow lets you kite his all-ins and Maiden helps you win the wave, but respect his Counter Strike (E) stun and his level-6 Grandmaster's Might in any extended fight.
edits.after: Around 3-6 it evens out — Mourning Mist's slow kites his all-ins and Maiden wins you the wave. Counter Strike dodges basic attacks, so your whole ghoul pack whiffs into it: pull the swarm back for its duration, then swing.

edits.before: Jax's Leap Strike (Q) plus Empower (W) gives him a burst combo that trades up on your slow melee autos; use your Mourning Mist (E) to mark him and slow him so you can walk away rather than sit in his stun window.
edits.after: Leap Strike (Q) plus Empower (W) gives him a burst combo that trades up on your slow autos. Dark Procession is terrain and stops the leap outright, so wall the ground between you rather than waiting out his 8s Q.

edits.before: Both of you unlock ults, but Jax's Grandmaster's Might (R) turns extended fights in his favour with the third-hit stun and huge resist swing, so don't get greedy stacking autos into him around the wall of his Counter Strike (E).
edits.after: Both unlock ults, but Grandmaster-at-Arms (R) swings extended fights his way — every third attack adds magic damage and the active raises his resists. The stun is Counter Strike, 17s at rank 1, and it dodges basics while it runs.

edits.before: Land Mourning Mist (E) to slow Jax and cage him in Dark Procession (W) when he Leaps in
edits.after: Wall the ground he Leap Strikes over — Dark Procession is terrain and stops the leap

edits.before: Force sidelane 1v1s where Grandmaster's Might resists shred your ghoul damage
edits.after: Force sidelane 1v1s where Grandmaster-at-Arms resists blunt your ghouls

notes: 'Grandmaster's Might' is the wrong ultimate name and appeared four times; Riot's data says Grandmaster-at-Arms. It was also credited with a third-hit stun it does not have. Biggest playable gain: Counter Strike dodges ALL incoming basic attacks, so the ghoul pack and the Maiden whiff into it too — the page previously read as if only your own autos were at risk.
